# Hollis Family Farm egg ledger

Wholesale orders and the farm stand are logged separately, one row per day, dozens of eggs.
The farm stand's ledger pages for 10-16 September went to the new bookkeeping system early and those pages didn't transfer; the bookkeeper is re-scanning them and expects them back by 6 October.

turns.prompt: How many dozens of eggs did Hollis Family Farm sell in September across wholesale and the farm stand?
